fr_html: LE PRESIDENT rappelle que déjà en 1907 on a consacré la règle de la juridiction obligatoire pour certains conflits internationaux.
en_html: The PRESIDENT pointed out that the rules of compulsory jurisdiction for certain international disputes had already been recognised in 1907.
